_scenario_name: Horizon HK — Hong Kong holdco, India engineering, IN engineer exercises
_narrative: Horizon Pay Ltd is a Hong Kong-incorporated payments group, parent of Horizon Tech India Pvt Ltd in Bengaluru. A senior engineer in India exercises 6,000 NSO-equivalents at HKD 0.30 strike, FMV HKD 3.00 on 30 April 2026. CFO's question: any Hong Kong tax obligation on the HK parent for an Indian employee? No — IRO s.8 nexus is absent; India perquisite tax applies via the Indian subsidiary.
